diversity_evidence: This sample does not establish the generator's overall diversity, but within it every story repeats the same kite-making premise, invitation to Pavel, small shared preparation, successful flight, and return of the reel. Variants such as Pavel guiding the tail or holding the reel are minor role substitutions rather than distinct causal plots (s000029, s000057, s000034, s000085); several entries are exact duplicates (s000029/s000047 and s000068/s000005).

plot_groups.summary: Nia includes new neighbor Pavel in making and flying a kite; he gains confidence through a chosen helping role, the kite flies successfully, and they return the borrowed reel together.
